summary.en: Conan and the Detective Boys go to a Beika coffee shop to meet up with Professor Agasa. Nearby, Ohara and Aida are having a meeting. Ohara gets up to go to the bathroom, and while he's gone, a truck slammed into the coffee shop and crushed Aida who is still seated. Conan realizes it wasn't the negligence of the driver but a murder. Location: Peach Sunday Cause of death: Truck collision Suspects: Jiro Kobayashi A truck slammed into the coffee shop and crushed Aida, resulting in his death.
